## Definition of done (AGENTS.md)

- [ ] `cargo xtask check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior (business rules named after the rule, e.g. `r04_...`)
- [ ] Reused existing components (docs/COMPONENTS.md); nothing duplicated
- [ ] docs/COMPONENTS.md updated for every new reusable component
- [ ] Crate `AGENTS.md` updated if its structure or rules changed
- [ ] Architecture change recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md (ADR)
- [ ] New ambiguity recorded in docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md instead of guessed
- [ ] No secrets, no real data, nothing from production
